tools.name: list_public_cve_records
tools.description: List cleared public Hacker Bob Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures records with cursor pagination and optional project or publication-status filters.

tools.name: get_public_cve_record
tools.description: Return one cleared Hacker Bob CVE record by identifier, including its open-source project, publication status, and upstream public record URL when available.

tools.name: search_public_cve_records
tools.description: Search cleared public Hacker Bob CVE records by CVE identifier, open-source project name, or publication status without contacting any assessment target.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Return current public boundaries and, when authenticated, workspace-specific tool reachability, scopes, and role requirements.

tools.name: get_my_account
tools.description: Return the authenticated account and the workspace bound to this agent connection.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List active Hacker Bob workspaces available to the authenticated account. The connection remains bound to its approved workspace.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Return the approved workspace and current membership role.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List workspace assets and current ownership-authorization state without contacting a target.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Return one workspace asset and its current authorization state.

tools.name: begin_domain_authorization
tools.description: Create a DNS TXT or HTTPS-file challenge proving control of a domain. This does not run an assessment.

tools.name: check_domain_authorization
tools.description: Check the previously issued DNS or HTTPS proof and update the asset authorization state.

tools.name: list_assessments
tools.description: List assessments and current run states in the approved workspace.

tools.name: get_assessment
tools.description: Return one assessment, its verified asset, current run state, and any pending human approval.

tools.name: prepare_assessment
tools.description: Create an immutable assessment for a verified stored asset and return a browser approval URL. This never contacts the target.

tools.name: launch_assessment
tools.description: Consume a recent human approval and submit the immutable assessment to Hacker Bob's managed queue. The target is resolved only from the stored verified asset.

tools.name: cancel_assessment
tools.description: Cancel an eligible queued or running assessment and reconcile any refundable reserved credit.

tools.name: list_findings
tools.description: List workspace findings with optional lifecycle and severity filters.

tools.name: get_finding
tools.description: Return one finding with evidence-safe lifecycle history and related asset metadata.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: List non-revoked reports released to the approved workspace.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Return one released, non-revoked workspace report. Pending review material and access credentials are never returned.

tools.name: get_credit_summary
tools.description: Return available, reserved, and used assessment credits for the approved workspace.

tools.name: list_audit_events
tools.description: List recent workspace audit events with optional actor, action, and time filters.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_public_cve_record, get_report · Private data: list_public_cve_records, get_public_cve_record, search_public_cve_records, begin_domain_authorization, prepare_assessment, get_report · Public sink: launch_assessment · Destructive: begin_domain_authorization, list_assessments, get_assessment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_public_cve_record, get_report · Private data: list_public_cve_records, get_public_cve_record, search_public_cve_records, begin_domain_authorization, prepare_assessment, get_report · Public sink: launch_assessment · Destructive: begin_domain_authorization, list_assessments, get_assessment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
